summary: Dispatches a 2-byte size query on an object, choosing between AudioStreamBufferRead and sub_587F64 based on a flag at this+0x10 (this[4]). Returns true iff the chosen read reports success (0). Used by QueuePop and NetworkBufferRead, suggesting an audio-stream vs network-buffer dual-path reader.

operations.description: Select the read path from the flag at this+0x10 (this[4]); non-zero routes to AudioStreamBufferRead, zero to sub_587F64.
Audio path: call AudioStreamBufferRead(*this, 0, 2) and test the result against 0.
Fallback path: call sub_587F64(*this, 0, 2) and test the result against 0.
Return true iff the selected read function returned 0.

unresolved: Semantics of the this+0x10 flag selecting between the two readers is unknown; callers QueuePop and NetworkBufferRead imply audio-stream vs network-buffer contexts.
